name: freight-cost-model
description: Freight Cost Model — carrier SaaS monorepo (Fastify API + Next.js web)

scripts.verify:ci: npm run secrets:scan && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run db:validate -w freight-cost-api && npm run migrations:verify && npm run migrations:contract && npm run migrations:go-approval-contract && npm run migrations:invitation-contract && npm run security:headers && npm run build && npm run audit:production && git diff --check && git diff --cached --check
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify:ci && npm run preflight:release -w freight-cost-api
scripts.verify:release:rateware: npm run verify:ci && npm run preflight:release -w freight-cost-api -- --require-rateware
